description: Implement a fix to prevent AttributeError crashes when processing batch extractions with List[T] response models. The solution should properly handle list-based responses while maintaining backward compatibility and hardening optional dependencies.
functional_requirements: Create a ListResponse class that subclasses list and carries raw response metadata for batch processing
Update the response model preparation logic to correctly handle List[T] types similar to Iterable[T] processing
Implement robust error handling for optional vertexai imports to prevent import crashes when the dependency is misconfigured
